claims.sentence: The ranked admission lists are published on the university's official website no later than August 18, 2026
You must submit your original education document and/or your education and qualification document
If you possess a document confirming priority or special admission rights, you must also submit it
You must complete this submission by August 21, 2026
If you submitted your application using the state services portals, you confirm your consent to enrollment and submit your original education document through the portal's functionality
You must do this by August 21, 2026, and if vacancies remain, by November 25, 2026
After the deadlines for submitting original documents pass, the university issues an enrollment order for applicants recommended by the admissions committee who submitted their original documents
For applicants who used the state services portals, the order is issued based on their portal-confirmed consent and the electronic duplicate of their education document
The order includes a name list of these individuals
The order and its list are posted on the next working day after issuance on the admissions committee's information board and on the university's official website
The enrollment order is issued only after you provide the original education documents, sign a contract for paid educational services, and pay for your tuition
You must provide the tuition payment receipt personally to the university or send it to college@innopolis.ru
The order will be issued no later than August 25, 2026
The evidence does not specify the consequences of missing the August 21, 2026 or November 25, 2026 submission deadlines
It does not detail the procedure for signing the paid education contract or the accepted payment methods
It does not explain how vacancies are determined or how the electronic duplicate is verified
It does not cover admission procedures for other educational programs or academic years
